texts.preamble: Hariprasath vs The Commissioner on 17 July, 2017 Bench: M.Sathyanarayanan, N.Seshasayee In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated:17.07.2017 Coram: The Honourable Mr. Justice M.Sathyanarayanan And The Honourable Mr. Justice N.Seshasayee W.P.No.17982/2017 Hariprasath .. Petition Vs 1.The Commissioner Corporation of Chennai Rippon Building, Chennai 600 003. 2.The Chairperson/Zonal Executive Engineer, [Zone-9], [The Tonwnship Vending Committee], Corporation of Chennai Chennai. .. Respondents Prayer:- Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for i For Petitioner : Mr.R.Kamaraj For Rr 1& 2 : Mr.A.Nagarajan Order
texts.arguments: 2 The petitioner claims that he is otherwise abled [differently abled] and he has been issued with the Disability Certificate by the District Disability Welfare Officer, Chennai and he would claim that he is running a Bunk Shop/Stall just opposite to Bharat Petrol Bunk, Teynampet, Chennai-18 and in the said shop, he is selling tea, coffee and food items in a hygienic manner by using LPG stove and out of the meager income earned, he is maintaining himself and his family. The petitioner would further state that in the light of the enactment of the Street Vendors [Protection of Livelihood Regulation] Act, 2014, he is entitled to avail the benefits under the said Act and in this regard, he has also submitted a representation dated 22.06.2017 to the 2nd respondent in person and the same was also acknowledged on the same day and it is yet to be disposed of.
